meaning:
κεφαλιόω (Rec. -αιόω, [so in LXX: Sir.32:8 *]), -ῶ
(κεφάλιον, dimin. of κεφαλή, in late writers)
1. (-αιόω) to sum up (Thuc., al.).
2. (In NT, only) to wound on the head: Mrk.12:4.†
(AS)

renderings.bsb: they struck him over the head
renderings.kjv: and wounded him in the head

elsewhere.note: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.
